page.layout: Two printed pages. Left page: the running head "INDEX" at the top, then three columns: a left column of Greek words with references, a middle column of Greek words with references, and at the foot of the middle column the letter "B." with its Greek entries. Right page (cut off at the scan edge): a narrow column of Greek words with a running head "IN" and page numbers at the top right.
page.notes: The right-hand page is cut off at the scan edge; its Greek words are largely unreadable and only the page numbers 86, 86, 86 and 93 are legible. The Greek in the left columns is only partly legible and many words are marked uncertain or illegible rather than guessed. The Greek words in the middle column were read approximately; treat the accents and letters with care. No catchword or signature is visible.
